title: Qangiinoh cokmih buxal reebime yaamineeni
intro: Qur’aanak elle yamixxigeh tan kaxxa-kaxxa gicloh abbobtih gilded halls addat — Divine defiance kulli edict elle baxxaqisan innal — inki rooci privileged fanat gexak, kaxxaam qaxmeqe sirritte qaddoysak suge. ta num quukah imaan tonnal waaso too gidaaritteh addat too geyto yaanam mango raba. Usuk uxih conviction laqna gubal tan laqna celtaah, woo wakti gufe wak, numma qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk qanxaffe luk suge.
clues: Anu inni waktil kaxxa caylaleeh, kaxxiinile miraacak addah maroh addat sugeeh, assakat kee diihay marrooweh suge.
Anu inni nummah aamanti inni sorkocô baxat qelliseh, inni manoh meysitak too qangiinoo kee zulmit miraacisak suge marak.
Yi ummatta numma foocal shakki luk sugteeh, ken Rabbih farmoytit cinneh sugteh tan taturte agattiinah addal tekkeh tan umaaneh addat ken diggoysuh fooca fanah gexe.
Anu inni ummattah kiciyyoh an qunxaaneyti soono le numih aydaadu kassiiseeh, usuk isi ramadih gabat qideeh, uxih kaxxa reeda fan gexeeh, xer baaxol.
Anu inni ummatta hoxat ken miraaciseh yan miraacah amri akah acee waan innah kassiiseeh, tohih aftok qadli kee miraaciini gitat yoo katayoonuh ken arcibiseh.
Anu qaduuk nummat yaabem takkay immay qanxaffe le kataysis yoo qide loonum akkek baaxok yoo diiriye lon.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
